_schema: qec_twin.code_status.v1 — hand-maintained status overlay for tools/gen_code_map.py. Keys = package paths relative to src/ (fully-qualified, e.g. 'qec_twin/forward', 'error_coupling_simulator/source'), OR dev-tooling package keys (prefixed by their repo-relative root, e.g. 'tools', 'tests/harness'), or a module path for a per-module override. status in {ACTIVE, PLACEHOLDER, ARCHIVED, TOOLING}. gen_code_map.py DRIFT-CHECKS this against the code: add an entry when a new package appears, remove one when a package is deleted (both are flagged in CODE_MAP.md's DRIFT CHECK). '_'-prefixed keys are config, not packages.

_local_index._note: Curated CLUSTERS of load-bearing LOCAL-ONLY working code under gitignored outputs/ (NOT committed; present on the build workstation). Maintain the GLOBS (stable); gen_code_map auto-discovers the FILES matching them, so new nm_*/cert_*/quantum_bath_* appear without editing this. Globs are relative to the repo root. NOTE: source/ has been re-homed into src/error_coupling_simulator/ (MIGRATION P1); the lower-level qutip oracle scripts remain local-only until an active consumer justifies re-homing. The outputs/teacher_prereg/ copies below are FROZEN LEGACY and are neither package data nor distribution defaults.

tools.note: dev tooling (NOT shipped): gen_code_map (this map generator, AST-only), sync_obsidian

tests/harness.note: Python test/coverage HARNESS (lives WITH the tests; replaces the .sh runners): fresh-process service_acceptance catalog runner with bounded CPU, CPU-exclusive, and GPU-serial lanes plus unique logs; proc (process-group supervisor — no orphaned workers); gpu_pool (flock lease + race-free child GPU environment, ECS_GPUS); gate + mutation registry-driven runners; coverage_audit (AST-derived per-unit coverage audit)

error_coupling_simulator.note: Self-contained simulator distribution: runtime ownership is package-local and has no inward qec_twin import. Exact wheel/sdist allowlists exclude outward repository shims, RAG tooling, and scratch assets; release acceptance uses a real sdist-to-wheel isolated-install core-smoke gate. It consumes a specified noise process and emits a syndrome record. There is no physical ground truth; evaluator-side parameters define the process and independent oracles are formal bug-catchers.

error_coupling_simulator/source.note: Axis-2 source layer (P3): process (productionized SourceTimeline) + coupling (Theta fan-out) consumed by specified noise processes. The lower-level wedge machinery (nm_*) + the qutip oracles were removed in the 2026-07-03 screening because no active process wires them.

error_coupling_simulator/mechanisms.note: Mechanism primitives and evaluator-side process fixtures: catalog, axis1_primitives, qutrit_teachers, seam_teachers, and Kraus/field builders. Old qec_twin.mechanisms.* paths are outward repository compatibility shims, excluded from distribution and never imported by this package. Record-to-parameter fitting and learner model comparisons are outside the simulator product.

error_coupling_simulator/quantum_bath.note: Pseudomode-enlarged shared-bath GKSL feasibility carrier: 2 data + 2 ancilla + one shared mode, exact-DM CPU, dual-axis syndrome record, and evaluator-side ground-truth controls. K/K_X/K_Z are forgeable by an incoherent AD, so the honest discriminator is model-free record distance.

error_coupling_simulator/frontend.note: User-facing package-local frontend: CircuitIR/CodeSpec/XZZX compiler, Stim import, sealed SubstepSchedule, .b8 record sampling, Axis-1 carrier execution/evidence, .b8 I/O, and the optional external-PyMatching adapter. Google r01/r10 files are explicit external circuit/schedule inputs. Ququart transport accepts package-derived channels from explicit CZ parameters, in-memory channels, or an optional serialized derived-channel cache; Kraus is not external data. CUDA-Q Grover is an optional plugin isolated in aiqec, not canonical ecs. Old qec_twin.simulator is an outward repository shim and is not shipped.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier.note: Forward propagation owner: joint_lindbladian, channels, exact/PEPS carriers, package-local RecordBatch/PackedShotBatch, and the active fused within-cycle host live here. The shipped 1D MPS implementations are restricted Axis-1 execution services under frontend, not the retired legacy thin-strip driver and not a production full-dxd carrier. Only fused within-cycle optimization uses c64/screening-only; final/certification and PEPS/MPS are c128. Old qec_twin.forward paths are repo-local compatibility shims and are excluded from distribution archives.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/exact.note: Exact qubit/qutrit/ququart density-matrix backend (feasibility-only; local dimension controls the ceiling). qutrit_dm and circuit_sim are canonical here; old qec_twin.forward.exact paths are outward repository shims excluded from the distribution. XZZX parsing is package-local under frontend.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/kernels.note: Fused CUDA/C++ kernels and loaders. Exact-forward fused Kraus remains c128 with its Torch reference; sv_traj_d3_wc has separate c64/c128 ABIs, with c64 restricted to optimization screening. Python/C++ guards pin dtype, device, shape, CSR bounds, CUDAGuard, and the current codestate stream. The canonical ecs environment supplies CUDA 13 and ninja.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/pepo.note: rung-1 2D DM-PEPO carrier for the rotated dxd XZZX patch (contract v4.3 / prereg v2.5). Engine E1-CERTIFIED FAITHFUL vs exact QutritDM (1e-15) + 50/51 pytest green. But the COMPILED-GEOMETRY carrier is CLOSED (2026-07-10): F-SEL-1 (selective sampling arm) + F-REC-1 (nonselective record law misses G1.2 by 25-40x at D=16) both falsified by first execution — the compiled weight-4 POVM concentrates circuit-distributed correlations onto fresh path bonds carrying flat rank-64 spectra (loop-closed rank probe: no lossless regauge exists). RETAINED as a findings package + the record-law/oracle substrate; the sampling arm moves to an ANCILLA-EXPLICIT rebuild (next architecture). Do NOT build new work on the selective born_sample_round path.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/peps.note: RUNG-B single-wire pure-state 2D PEPS carrier for rotated dxd XZZX. The compiled sqrt(E_s) POVM avoids doubled-wire rank squaring; state, contraction, trajectory, sampling-map, and loop diagnostics remain referee-independent from exact QutritDM. It uses package-local WithinCycleScheduleHost, temporal folding, and PackedShotBatch, while still accepting an injected host. PEPS is GPU c128-only; fused-SV c64 policy does not amend PEPS/FET. The registered d3 state-level spike is green, while finite-truncation faithfulness of the complete multi-round record remains open under ADR 0011; d5/d7 distributional claims remain provisional.

error_coupling_simulator/certify.note: Evaluator-side noise-process certification seam: record schema, compatibility protocol, certify_cells scoring, and independent Anchor/Control ports. c128 metadata makes an artifact only a certification candidate, never an automatic pass. Decoder reduction is an optional frontend instrument; retained R2 ingestion stays outside simulator runtime.

error_coupling_simulator/certify/anchors.note: P4: independent-ground-truth anchor ports (DM-oracle / stim-clifford / closed-form / controls) — anti-circular referees.

error_coupling_simulator/noise_processes.note: Evaluator-only specified record processes. CoupledCycleNoiseProcess maps a memoryful 1/f source to per-round Axis-1 parameters and emits sealed dense {det,obs} records with matched_marginal_permutation_control (exchangeable at finite R, not a genuinely Markovian generative null; markovian_baseline is only its compatibility spelling) and a source-off control. Record-to-parameter fitting is outside this package boundary.
